title: Hawaiian Pizza

ingredients.title: Dough (Neapolitan-Style)
items: 250 g (2 cups) “00” flour (or bread flour if unavailable)
2 g (½ tsp) fresh yeast (or ¾ tsp instant yeast)

ingredients.title: Sauce (Light Italian Tomato Base)
items: 150 g (½ cup) San Marzano tomatoes (canned, hand-crushed)

ingredients.title: Toppings
items: 150 g (5 oz) fresh mozzarella (fior di latte), torn into small pieces
70 g (2½ oz) thinly sliced Italian prosciutto cotto (ham)
60 g (2 oz) fresh pineapple, small cubes (ripe, lightly char-grilled for extra depth)
Extra virgin olive oil, to drizzle

instruction.title: Step 1 – Dough Preparation (24 hrs fermentation for best flavor)
steps: In a bowl, dissolve yeast in water. Add flour gradually, mixing by hand or mixer until shaggy dough forms.
Add salt and olive oil; knead until smooth and elastic (8–10 minutes).
Rest dough in a covered container at room temperature for 1 hour.
Refrigerate 12–24 hours (slow fermentation enhances flavor and digestibility).
Remove 2–3 hours before baking, shape into a ball, and allow to rise at room temp.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Sauce
steps: Heat olive oil gently in a pan, add garlic clove, and lightly infuse. Remove garlic.
Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, and salt. Simmer 10 minutes, then cool.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assembly
steps: Preheat oven with pizza stone or steel to 250°C (480°F) (or as hot as possible).
Stretch dough gently into a 12-inch circle—avoid using a rolling pin (keeps air pockets).
Spread thin layer of sauce (don't over-sauce).
Add prosciutto cotto slices and charred pineapple pieces.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Baking
steps: Bake 6–8 minutes on pizza stone/steel until crust is golden with charred spots, cheese bubbling.
If using wood-fired oven: bake at 430°C (800°F) for ~90 seconds.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Finish & Serve
steps: Slice and serve hot, with crust crisp outside and airy inside.

chefTips: Lightly grilling pineapple caramelizes sugars, avoiding excess sweetness and giving balance with the savory ham and creamy mozzarella.
Use fior di latte mozzarella instead of pre-shredded cheese for authentic texture and flavor.
